papers.title: A Comparison of Five Multiple Instance Learning Pooling Functions for Sound Event Detection with Weak Labeling
papers.findings: Section2/Table1 derives weighted pooling derivatives; negative bags can learn high weights on low instance predictions, separating bag success from localization. Selected p3 discussion/Table2 distinguishes tagging and localization endpoints.
papers.limits: pp1-3 only. Binary independent-event probabilities in[0,1] and BCE under the standard at-least-one-positive-instance assumption; native40-class logits use signed affine utilities and joint CE. No full code/results reproduction or localization transfer.

papers.title: A Multiclass Multiple Instance Learning Method with Exact Likelihood
papers.findings: Section2 defines class-set binary-vector labels, background class and per-location categorical probability normalization. Assumption1 is conditional independence of location emissions; Proposition1/Eqs4-8 use products and inclusion-exclusion. p8 discusses correlated-label degeneracy and begins AppendixA.
papers.limits: pp1-4,8 selected reading; only part of AppendixA inspected. No complete proof/code/experiment audit. Native word-wise Born weights are not per-word categorical class emissions or exact OR-set likelihood; relation label does not annotate which words carry the relation.

papers.title: Increasing Information Extraction in Low-Signal Regimes via Multiple Instance Learning
papers.findings: Sections1/3 Eq3 uses iid collision events and sums event log-likelihood ratios. Section3.1 sqrt(N) SNR argument assumes independent homogeneous events. Section3.2 Eq15 concerns effective information lost to learned bag-LLR errors with a sublinear error-variance condition; it does not create extra raw information.
papers.limits: pp1-6 selected; no complete appendices, simulation/architecture reproduction or error-model certification. The source explicitly says distributed weak signal rather than finding one key instance. Contextualized words in one sentence and current CE/Macro target are not this statistical experiment. Eq12 variance/error covariance and quantitative approximation assumptions not independently certified here.
